facts.fact: Chathu's hunters shut the Resin House gate the day after Devan's party left, while the sun was high, on their own scouting of who remained. Vasu, sent by Pavi, saw it barred from the cairn before the tapping bell, was held overnight at the flooded ford, and reached Kettamala at first grey. Tonight's jar only confirms what Chathu already did.
Eravi's drunken wrong dose, the tapper's widow, and Fourth Guard's salve pot as a message conduit are established by this chapter.
Bhaskaran rode back with Devan the morning before the chapter; Vasu leads the six men and Pavi outside the Resin House wall in the sheds.
Eravi overheard the cart order in the passage outside the sickroom after the bear; he saw the sword hilt toward Neela during Devan's arrow fever.
